text:
mira-sales: Gamma client POC reports sudden 5xxs during a demo ramp. They used our SDK and hit 120rps in <2 minutes. Need rapid triage and a short mitigation plan.
sam-support: Got it. Any stack traces or request ids? Also confirm if they're on Dedicated and whether burstpool is enabled.
gamma-client: sample error:
```
2026-05-12T09:05:42Z ERROR req=gamma999 code=500 msg=worker_oom model=redwood-13b
2026-05-12T09:05:43Z WARN req=gamma999 queue_ms=2100
```
noah-se: Interesting: worker_oom suggests a model size + batch combo caused OOM. But they said earlier logs had capacity_throttled too. Could be multiple failure modes during ramp.
leo-eng: Can someone check node/gpu utilization and runtime OOM traces? If workers OOM we should switch to smaller variant or enable quantized profile.
scale-bot: autoscaler_event id=as-2026-55 created=2026-05-12T09:06:10Z from=3 to=6 reason=queue_latency_spike
mira-sales: Customer wants two things: 1) fix immediate demo so they can continue, 2) understand what configuration caused OOM and how to avoid in production.
sam-support: Immediate fixes to propose:
- fallback to rwd-7b_small or rwd-7b-quantized
- reduce batch_size and max_tokens on client requests
- temporary manual scale to give headroom for the demo
noah-se: Longer-term: add model-version pinning with quantized variant for POC, add preflight validation that simulates expected concurrency and tokens to flag potential OOM.
leo-eng: For triage run these commands and paste outputs:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.total,memory.free --format=csv -l 1 -f /tmp/gpu.csv
rg "worker_oom|capacity_throttled" /var/log/runtime/*.log | tail -n 200
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | awk '{print $1, $3, $6}'
```
sam-support: Also collect failing request_id gamma999 trace across scheduler and worker logs.
gamma-client: applying client-side reduction: max_tokens=256, concurrency=40 -> reducing now. Will retest in 10m.
mira-sales: Can we give an estimate for cost of manual scale to 6 GPUs for 1 hour?
sam-support: Rough: hourly_gpu_cost * 3 extra gpus * hours. I'll confirm with finance.
scale-bot: note: as_event as-2026-55 scaled 3->6 at 09:06:10 but pods ready at 09:07:20 (70s).
noah-se: That readiness delay likely made the difference. Add to runbook: pre-warm extra pods before scheduled demos for customers expecting big ramps.
leo-eng: Add immediate playbook steps:
1) enable fallback_variant: rwd-7b-quant
2) patch autoscaler cooldown to 30s for the POC namespace
3) manual scale to desired replicas and wait for readiness
4) after demo, revert config
sam-support: I'll open SUP-2026-FF-331 and attach logs + recommended playbook.
gamma-client: Thanks, we spun down concurrency and demo resumed. We'll run a second, slower ramp later.
mira-sales: Great. I'll document playbook and share with the customer. Keep this thread for the follow-up notes on root cause.
